% Pattern: head/misspelled. The paper writes its heads by hand in bold and
% misspells some titles by one letter, as "Defnition", "Thoerem" and
% "Proposision". A numbered head with a misspelled title is an item of the
% kind of the title; one with no number is not. Seen in the gold pilot (set X).
% want head-1 definition 1.1
% want head-2 statement/theorem 1.2
% want head-3 statement/proposition 1.3
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\section{One}
\textbf{Defnition 1.1.} A space is nice when it is compact.

\textbf{Thoerem 1.2.} Every compact space is bounded.

\textbf{Proposision 1.3.} Every finite space is compact.

\textbf{Defnition.} A space is fine when it is finite.
\end{document}
